Class TrackDestination

java.lang.Object
model.effect.destination.TrackDestination
All Implemented Interfaces:
MysteryCellDestination
Direct Known Subclasses:
AlphaDestination, ApproachDestination, BetaDestination, EntryDestination, GammaDestination
public abstract class TrackDestination extends Object implements MysteryCellDestination
Base class of the destinations that lie on the shared track (T-11), written as a Template Method. receive(Player, List, GameMessagePublisher) is final and always does the same steps: it places the pieces on the cell, records the arrival, announces the teleport, and applies the effect if the activation rule allows it. A subclass only says which cell it is and what the arrival does.
